name: cafe_table
notes: 0.80 m diameter clipped plank top; 0.750 m tabletop.
Slim 50 mm round pedestal with 44 mm bore; 36 mm clear top grommet fits the coordinated 32 mm umbrella mast.
Flat 22 x 16 mm foot arms attach to the round pedestal and ground pads; 8 mm clearance above the coordinated 28 mm ballast plate.
